title: Capture admin and auth feature doc screenshots
description:
Problem: admin/auth documentation includes new screenshot placeholders but lacks captured evidence images.

Desired outcome: capture and embed screenshots for admin/auth feature documentation while applying strict privacy redaction.

Scope:
- In scope: placeholders `FEAT-ADMIN-01..04` in `features/admin-and-auth`; capture, redact, store in `Data/Pages/assets`, and embed in markdown.
- Out of scope: non-admin feature pages and production-infrastructure screenshots.

Acceptance criteria:
- All FEAT-ADMIN placeholder IDs are fulfilled with image assets and markdown embeds.
- Captures remove or mask sensitive account identifiers and environment-specific secrets.
- Page renders correctly in `/pages` with all linked assets.

Validation:
- Open `features/admin-and-auth` in `/pages` and verify each image renders.
- Confirm redaction pass is complete before commit.

comments.author: AgentSmith
comments.body: Created to track FEAT-ADMIN screenshot capture with privacy-focused redaction requirements.
